subject: PO requirements, packaging fields, and payment lane constraints
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@greenbridge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@greenbridge.com
Date: 2027-04-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO fields & packaging constraints for upcoming deployment

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at GreenBridge is excited to move forward. Before we generate a formal PO, procurement asked me to confirm a few requirements that drive how we set pricing and discounts on our end. Can you confirm the following so we can align with our AP and legal teams?

1) PO fields: Our ERP requires a PO to include a specific set of line-item metadata (cost center, BU code, contract reference, GL account). Can you accept PO uploads with custom field mapping (we'll attach our PO template)?

2) Invoice cadence & net terms: We typically operate on Net45 for new vendors. We saw your standard Net30 discount tiers — will accepting Net45 nullify eligibility for the proposed 7% term discount, or is there a way to structure around it (e.g., earlier prepayment for slab discount)?

3) Packaging & SKU mapping: We need per-environment SKUs for stage vs prod so finance can map usage accordingly. Are you able to emit separate invoice lines per deployment tag, or do you only do consolidated monthly aggregates?

4) Payment rail & remittance: Our AP team requires ACH details and a remit email on the invoice. Any objections to listing our remit code on invoices (we provide the exact string)?

I've attached our PO template for reference (GreenBridge_PO_Template.pdf). We're aiming to have a PO in your system by 2027-05-07 pending these clarifications.

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement is on a tight internal timeline.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Wu
Director, Procurement
GreenBridge Health

--- Attachment (1) ---
GreenBridge_PO_Template.pdf (PDF)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields & packaging constraints for upcoming deployment

Alex — great to hear, congrats to your team. Short answers up front, then details below so your AP/legal can confirm:

- PO field mapping: Yes — we can accept PO uploads and map custom fields into our billing system. We support a mapping file (CSV) during vendor onboarding; Marissa is our billing ops lead and will coordinate the mapping.

- Net terms vs discount: Our published discount tiers assume Net30. For Net45 we typically reduce the term-sensitive discount by 1.5–2 percentage points. That said, there are two alternative patterns that often work: (1) schedule a partial prepay (e.g., 25% up-front) to preserve the slab discount, or (2) agree to monthly statements with a one-time accelerated payment window for the initial commit. Vanessa, copied, can confirm the specific math for GB-2319.

- Packaging/SKU per environment: We can produce invoice lines grouped by deployment tag. We can provide per-environment invoicing (one invoice with multiple lines) or separate invoices per deployment if your ERP prefers. Note: separate invoices may affect consolidation discounts.

- Remittance: No problem listing your remit code on invoices. We will publish ACH details on the invoice footer and send a payment details doc (Redwood_Billing_Reference.xlsx).

Attached a short onboarding checklist — Marissa will pick up the PO template and requested field mapping. If you can share the exact Net45 request and whether you'd consider a partial prepay, Vanessa will run the discount scenarios and reply with the final offer.

Action items:
- Alex: confirm whether partial prepay is possible (yes/no) and share the ERP field mapping sample (CSV)
- Marissa: initiate PO field mapping intake
- Vanessa: produce discount delta for Net45 and partial-prepay options

I can hop on a 30-minute call if that helps accelerate.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--- Attachments (2) ---
Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.docx (docx)
Redwood_Billing_Reference.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@greenbridge.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields & packaging constraints for upcoming deployment

Hi Alex — looping in the discount/pricing side. Quick guidance below and a worked example at the bottom.

Summary: Net45 will reduce the tiered term discount that was modeled for Net30. We can preserve most of the economic value with either (A) a 25% upfront payment (preserves the original 7% slab), or (B) accept Net45 but shift to a lower permanent discount of 5.25% on committed spend. For one-time onboarding credits we can offer a $10k implementation credit irrespective of payment cadence.

Invoice structure options (pick one):
- Single monthly invoice with per-environment lines (recommended) — easiest for us and keeps your ERP reconciliation simple.
- Separate invoices per environment — supported, but note it will create three invoice IDs per month (stage, prod, dev) and may complicate your accounts payable.

PO field mapping: Marissa will provide the mapping template. We map up to 12 custom fields (cost center, BU, contract ref, project id, GL account, tax jurisdiction, legal entity, bill-to code, remit code, PO line id, sku_tag, deployment_tag). If your ERP supplies a CSV with header rows matching those fields we can do a direct import.

Worked example (assumes $300k committed annual):
- Net30 + 7% term discount => effective $279k
- Net45 => offer 5.25% => effective $284.25k
- Partial 25% prepay + rest Net45 + preserves 7% on committed slab => effective ~ $280k + improved cashflow for us

Marissa: please attach the mapping CSV and a sample invoice export for a staged account so Alex's AP can validate.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@greenbridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@greenbridge.com

Subject: Re: PO fields & packaging constraints for upcoming deployment

Connor/Vanessa — thanks, this is exactly what procurement and AP needed. Two quick confirmations from our side: 

1) We will accept the 25% partial prepay to preserve the 7% slab discount. Procurement will issue the PO with the prepay line item and the remainder as monthly billing Net45.

2) Attached is our field mapping CSV and the ERP remit code to include on invoices.

We expect to upload the PO to your vendor portal by 2027-05-07 and target first invoice for 2027-06-01.

Please confirm when Marissa has completed the field mapping so we can close this loop.

Best,
Alex
